facts.claim: Malphite is a massive creature of living stone and the surviving shard of the Monolith.
His kit includes a rechargeable Granite Shield and the ground-impact ultimate Unstoppable Force.

source.title: Malphite (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Malphite's signature combat pattern combines ground slams with a charge that knocks enemies into the air.

source.title: Malphite - Leaguepedia | League of Legends Esports Wiki

facts.claim: Malzahar is a Shuriman seer who believes the Void is the path to Runeterra's salvation.
His kit centers on Voidlings and Malefic Visions that spread between dying units.
The secondary ability reference identifies Void Swarm, portals from Call of the Void, and the channelled suppression of Nether Grasp.

source.title: Malzahar - Leaguepedia | League of Legends Esports Wiki

facts.claim: Maokai is a towering treant and nature spirit fighting the horrors of the Shadow Isles after surviving through Waters of Life.
His passive heals him through empowered attacks and has its cooldown reduced by spell activity.
The secondary gameplay reference highlights Sapling Toss, including saplings that chase enemies and become stronger in brush.

source.title: Maokai (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

emojiCandidates.meaning: Waters of Life in his heartwood

facts.claim: Master Yi is one of the last living practitioners of the Ionian martial art of Wuju.
His kit includes Double Strike, Alpha Strike, Meditate, Wuju Style, and Highlander, combining repeated attacks, vanishing movement, healing, and speed.
The secondary ability reference confirms Alpha Strike's untargetable multi-target strikes, Meditate healing, Wuju true damage, and Highlander reset potential.

source.title: Master Yi | League of Legends Wiki

emojiCandidates.meaning: vanishing and becoming untargetable during Alpha Strike

facts.claim: Mel Medarda is a Noxian aristocrat and heir whose encounter with the Black Rose awakens new magic.
Mel gains bonus projectiles from casting and applies Overwhelm stacks that can execute a target.
The secondary character reference describes Mel's reflective magic and connection to the Black Rose and Arcane setting.

source.title: Mel (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

unresolved: Unicode has no dedicated symbol for projectile reflection or Overwhelm; the set relies on the Black Rose plus mirror combination.

facts.claim: Milio is an Ixtali boy who mastered the fire axiom and discovered soothing fire.
His abilities enchant allies with extra burning damage, kick a ball, create protective flames, and heal or cleanse allies.
The secondary character reference identifies Milio's signature fuemigos as small, bouncy fire elementals that heal and soothe wounds.

source.title: Milio (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

unresolved: There is no dedicated fuemigo emoji, so 🧸 is a friendly companion proxy rather than a literal match.

facts.claim: Miss Fortune is a Bilgewater captain and bounty hunter who avenged her family by destroying Gangplank's flagship.
Her kit includes Love Tap, Double Up, Make It Rain, and Bullet Time, with bonus damage when switching targets.
The secondary gameplay reference confirms her marksman identity and the signature gun-focused abilities that culminate in Bullet Time.

source.title: Miss Fortune | League of Legends Wiki

facts.claim: Mordekaiser is an iron revenant and necromantic warlord who binds souls into servitude.
After three attacks or spells he gains a damage aura, and Realm of Death drags an enemy into another dimension.
The secondary lore reference ties his spectral power to the brutal mace Nightfall and an empire built from enslaved souls.

source.title: The Iron Revenant - Universe | League of Legends Wiki

facts.claim: Morgana is conflicted between celestial and mortal natures and binds her wings to embrace humanity.
Her signature kit includes Dark Binding, Black Shield, and Soul Shackles made from dark fire and chains.
The secondary ability reference confirms her healing from spell damage, cursed shadow zone, binding root, and magic-protecting Black Shield.

source.title: Morgana - Leaguepedia | League of Legends Esports Wiki

facts.claim: Naafiri is a Darkin power carried by a pack of Shuriman dune hounds.
Her passive spawns packmates, while Darkin Daggers cause bleeding and call the pack to attack.
The secondary character reference describes Naafiri's host as a pack with shared hunting instincts and a dagger-shaped Darkin identity.

source.title: Naafiri (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

unresolved: The dog emoji is a generic proxy for a Shuriman dune hound and does not convey the Darkin dagger by itself.

facts.claim: Nami is a Marai vastaya of the seas who uses her Tidecaller staff to summon ocean power.
Her ability names and kit include Aqua Prison, Ebb and Flow, Tidecaller's Blessing, and Tidal Wave.
The secondary gameplay reference describes her bubble suspension, bouncing water stream, ally empowerment, and tidal wave knock-up.

source.title: Nami (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Nasus is a jackal-headed Ascended guardian of knowledge from ancient Shurima.
His kit combines life steal, the stack-building Siphoning Strike, and a large sandstorm transformation.
The secondary ability reference confirms that killing units with Siphoning Strike permanently increases its stacks and that Fury of the Sands reduces its cooldown.

unresolved: Unicode has no jackal emoji, so 🐺 is used as the closest recognizable canine-beast proxy.

facts.claim: Nautilus is an armored goliath and lonely legend of Bilgewater's dark waters who swings an enormous anchor.
His passive roots targets on the first attack, and Depth Charge sends a shockwave through the ground to knock enemies up.
The secondary gameplay reference confirms Dredge Line as an anchor hook that drags Nautilus and an enemy together.

source.title: Nautilus (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Neeko is a vastaya who can blend into a crowd by borrowing the appearances and emotional state of others.
Inherent Glamour disguises Neeko as allies or map units, while Shapesplitter and Blooming Burst support her deceptive and colorful play pattern.
The secondary character reference identifies chameleon-like traits and shapeshifting through another being's Sho'ma.

source.title: Neeko (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

unresolved: Unicode has no dedicated chameleon emoji, so 🦎 is a reptile proxy.

facts.claim: Nidalee is a jungle tracker who shapeshifts into a ferocious cougar and hunts with traps and spear throws.
Her Prowl passive rewards brush movement, while Javelin Toss or Bushwhack marks a target as Hunted for empowered cougar attacks.
The secondary gameplay reference confirms the human/cougar forms, long-range javelin, Bushwhack trap, and Hunted Pounce sequence.

source.title: Nidalee (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Nilah is an ascetic warrior empowered by the demon of joy, Ashlesh, and channels its liquid form into a blade.
Her passive shares enhanced healing and shielding, while Jubilant Veil lets her dodge incoming attacks in mist.
The secondary development reference identifies the urumi whip-like sword, Ashlesh's forced perpetual joy, and water-based whirlpool combat.

unresolved: There is no Unicode emoji for an urumi or the Seventh Layer; the blade and water combination is an inference.

facts.claim: Nocturne is a faceless demonic amalgamation of nightmares, darkness, and wicked blades.
His kit uses Umbra Blades, Shroud of Darkness, Unspeakable Horror, and Paranoia to heal, block a spell, fear a target, and attack through darkness.
The secondary ability reference describes Paranoia as a global sight reduction followed by a dash to the target.

source.title: Nocturne (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Nunu and Willump are a boy and a magical yeti bound by friendship and a shared love of snowballs in the Freljord.
Their kit includes Consume, Biggest Snowball Ever!, Snowball Barrage, and Absolute Zero, with a passive that empowers Willump and an ally.
The secondary gameplay reference confirms the rolling snowball engage and the channelling blizzard of Absolute Zero.

source.title: Nunu & Willump (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

emojiCandidates.meaning: large furry yeti proxy for Willump

unresolved: Unicode has no dedicated yeti emoji, so 🐻 is a large-furry-companion proxy.

facts.claim: Olaf is an axe-wielding Freljordian berserker who seeks a glorious death in combat.
Berserker Rage grants more attack speed and life steal as Olaf loses health, and Undertow throws an axe that can be picked up to reset its cooldown.
The secondary gameplay reference confirms the axe throw, missing-health berserker scaling, and Ragnarok's combat identity.

source.title: Olaf (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Orianna is a technological clockwork being accompanied by a brass sphere she built for companionship and protection.
Her abilities command The Ball to attack, create a pulse field, shield an ally, and release a shockwave.
The secondary gameplay reference confirms that the Ball can attach to allies and that Command: Shockwave pulls enemies toward it.

source.title: Orianna (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Ornn is the Freljordian spirit of forging and craftsmanship who works beneath a volcano with a trusty hammer.
Living Forge lets Ornn forge items anywhere, and Call of the Forge God summons a massive elemental that can be redirected.
The secondary gameplay reference highlights Ornn's magma pillar, belched fire, Brittle debuff, and masterwork crafting.

source.title: Ornn (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Pantheon is Atreus reborn after surviving the death of the Aspect of War, wielding the fallen Aspect's spear and shield.
His passive empowers every few spells or attacks, while Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front and strikes with his spear.
The secondary ability reference confirms Shield Vault's stun, Aegis Assault's directional invulnerability, and Grand Starfall's spear-and-landing attack.

source.title: Pantheon (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

emojiCandidates.meaning: shield vault impact and spear combo

facts.claim: Poppy is a determined Demacian yordle carrying Orlon's legendary hammer while searching for the Hero of Demacia.
Iron Ambassador throws a bouncing buckler that can be picked up for a shield, and Steadfast Presence stops enemy dashes.
The secondary character reference emphasizes Poppy's yordle physiology, oversized hammer, buckler, and long-running Demacian mission.

source.title: Poppy (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Pyke is a Bilgewater harpooner who died inside a jaull-fish and returned as a supernatural monster hunting exploiters.
When hidden Pyke regenerates recent champion damage and converts extra maximum health into bonus attack damage.
The secondary gameplay reference confirms Bone Skewer, Ghostwater camouflage, Phantom Undertow, and the low-health execution of Death from Below.

source.title: Pyke (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom
